headline: Jensen Huang's Return Sends NVIDIA Up More Than 30%
summary: Nvidia shares surged more than 30% after Jensen Huang's return, adding $959.7 billion to the chipmaker's market capitalization to reach $3.985 trillion on Monday.
why: Nvidia designs AI and graphics chips and is one of the largest companies by market value, so its share moves influence major indexes.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: The story reports a direct share price surge and a rise in the company's market capitalization.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Shares rose after Jensen Huang's return to the company, lifting its market value by about $960 billion on Monday.
original_headline: Regreso de Jensen Huang dispara más de 30% a NVIDIA
